issues.reason: The introduction claims two heritages but the actual table lists four; all four are preserved for review.
Arctic Fur mixes environmental cold protection and Ice resistance.
Gore, Lion's Claws and Hornless require distinct natural attack calculations.
Class favored bonuses, limits and fractional increments need independent tracking.

excludedSections.reason: External feats and archetypes belong in independent rules files.
External feats and archetypes belong in independent rules files.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Begin with Common and Ronsaur; bonus languages for high Intelligence: Galkan, Giant, Goblin, Lalafellan, Orc.

features.name: Arctic Fur
features.description: Environmental damage protection below 40°F; below 0°F treat extreme cold as normal cold, and grant Ice resistance 5.

features.name: Fearless
features.description: +2 racial saves against fear spells or effects.

features.name: Mountaineers
features.description: +2 Climb, altitude sickness immunity, and retain Dex AC while climbing or crossing narrow/slippery surfaces.

features.name: Fearsome
features.description: +4 racial Intimidate; loses both ordinary Intimidating Build and Survivalist.

features.name: Hornless
features.description: -4 Diplomacy, Bluff and Intimidate against other Ronso and +1 all Will saves; replaces Gore.

features.name: Lion's Claws
features.description: Two primary claw attacks dealing 1d4 each instead of Arctic Fur.

features.name: Magehunter
features.description: +2 Spellcraft to identify cast spells, +1 attacks against creatures casting spells (not spell-like abilities alone).

features.name: Helion Hrothgar Heritage Benefit
features.description: Orc Ferocity: Once a day continue one round as disabled after dropping below 0 HP, then begin dying unless healed.

features.name: Lost Hrothgar Heritage Benefit
features.description: Cat's Luck: Once a day, declare before Reflex save, roll twice and take higher.

features.name: Revgaji Heritage Benefit
features.description: Fortune's Favored: Reroll a single die once per day.

features.name: Yeti Heritage Benefit
features.description: Stability: +4 CMD on grounded bull rush and trip defense.
